name: (01) Thaumaturgy (Path of the Father's Vengeance) — 1 Basic — The Crone's Pride

system.description:
Speaking of the loathsome Crone who first bound Caine, the thaumaturge lays her hideous aspect upon a victim, twisting a fair face into something repulsive to all who behold it.

These powers affect only Cainites, and invoking one requires you to speak the relevant passage of the Curse aloud within earshot of your target. Recite a description of the Crone and defeat your victim in a Mental Challenge; on a win they suffer the Nosferatu clan disadvantage for the rest of the night, gaining the Negative Social Traits Repugnant x3 and being unable to bid or count Alluring, Gorgeous or Seductive. Retest with Occult.
